show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/NLe43V
show.description: A humiliated middle-class college student’s life changes overnight when he discovers he is the hidden heir to a billion-dollar business empire. As he rises from heartbreak to power, he takes revenge on the people who betrayed and mocked him, while struggling to protect the one girl who truly loved him for who he was. Packed with romance, betrayal, luxury, and mass hero moments, Rajadhirajan is an emotional billionaire revenge drama about love, status, and destiny.
